_about: The logging lesson 16.1 asks for. Each key is one telemetry source the simulator writes only if it is true here.
name: hardened
_foundry_resource_logs: Diagnostic setting with Audit, RequestResponse and Trace to the workspace (AzureDiagnostics), plus AllMetrics (AzureMetrics).
_apim_llm_logs: Log LLM messages on, prompts and completions up to 32768 bytes, 30-day retention, workspace readable by the incident group only.
_defender_ai_services: AI services plan On, with user prompt evidence. The app passes user_security_context (end_user_id, source_ip, application_name) on every chat call.
_agent_traces: Foundry tracing to Application Insights: invoke_agent and execute_tool spans with tool arguments.
_storage_logs: StorageBlobLogs (write operations) on the knowledge base storage account only.
_deploy_log: The agent pipeline writes one record per toolbox or agent change into the workspace.
_app_log_identity: Request ID, signed-in user, session ID, the gateway correlation ID, whether a content filter blocked the call, and token counts per request.
